content:
Post 1
📉 Five-day losing streak, a 100-day low, and every sector in the red. ASX 200 fell 137.80pts or 1.58% to 8,592.60. Down 5.39% this week alone. The broad selloff left nowhere to hide. #ASX #ausbiz

Post 2
Tech led the carnage at -4.70%, dragging the index lower. Materials fell 2.15%, Telecoms 1.80%, Industrials 1.79%. Not one sector closed green. Defensive plays like Utilities held best at -0.53%. #ASX #ausbiz #tech

Post 3
📉 MP1 was the session's wreckage — Megaport shed 12.89% to AUD14.940. Perenti followed at -11.23%. On the other side, lithium names PLS +2.34% and ELV +2.10% were the rare bright spots. #ASX #lithium

Post 4
🪙 Gold hit AUD5,331.14/oz as risk-off sentiment dominated. Silver at AUD63.02/oz. With AUD/USD at 0.6679, metals in local currency terms remain elevated — a partial cushion for gold miners in a rough week. #gold #ASX #metals

Post 5
ASX sits at a 100-day low with -1.40% YTD now erased into negative. Watch whether 8,592 holds Monday. Does tech find a floor or does the selloff deepen? Drop your level below. #ASX #ausbiz #trading
